name: dropkick_bomber_grant_ends_with_the_turn
notes: M7 mapper. Printed: '{R}: Until end of turn, another target Goblin you control gains flying and "When this creature deals combat damage, sacrifice it."' Seat 0 activates on its Goblin Raider and does not attack. On seat 0's next turn both grants are gone: the Raider (2/2 with the anthem) attacks without flying, so Opp Ogre is offered the block (it declines); the Raider deals 2 combat damage to seat 1 and is not sacrificed.
